definition.description: Total cumulative tobacco smoking exposure measured in pack-years.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the total number of pack-years of smoking history from the patient's social or medical history. If the patient is explicitly documented as a 'never smoker', the value is 0.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if smoking status is not mentioned, or if the patient is identified as a current or former smoker but no numeric pack-year value is provided.
definition.name: tobacco_smoking_history

definition.description: The total concentration of bilirubin in the blood serum.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value for total bilirubin from the laboratory data, typically located within the Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP) or a liver function panel.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the value is not documented, is ambiguous, or cannot be converted to a numeric value.
definition.name: total_bilirubin

definition.description: The mutation status of the TP53 gene in tumor tissue.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the TP53 mutation status from molecular pathology or next-generation sequencing (NGS) reports. Assign 'Mutant' if a pathogenic or likely pathogenic mutation is identified (e.g., 'TP53 mutation', 'missense mutation', or specific variants like R273C, R273H, R175H). Assign 'Wild-type' if the report explicitly states 'Wild-type' or 'no pathogenic variants detected'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if TP53 status is not documented, not tested, or the results are ambiguous.
definition.name: tp53_mutation_status

definition.description: Detection status of the TP53 R273H mutation in tumor tissue.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if the TP53 R273H mutation is identified as present, detected, or positive in molecular profiling or genomic reports (e.g., NGS).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no molecular profiling is documented or if the TP53 status is mentioned without specifying the R273H variant.
definition.name: tp53_r273h_mutation_status

definition.description: A numeric prognostic score (TPS) recorded in the patient's pretreatment clinical documentation.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value explicitly labeled as the TPS score from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent missing or ambiguous documentation as null.
definition.name: tps_score

definition.description: Presence of cerebrospinal fluid seepage across the ventricular ependymal lining into the surrounding brain parenchyma.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the neuroimaging report explicitly mentions 'transependymal flow' or 'periventricular signal abnormality' suggestive of CSF seepage. If reported as 'no transependymal flow', the value is Absent; if reported as present or evidence of seepage is noted, the value is Present.
definition.missing_value_rule: If transependymal flow is not mentioned or is ambiguous, record as null.
definition.name: transependymal_flow

definition.description: The duration of the interval between successive treatment cycles.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical number of days between treatment cycles. If the frequency is reported in weeks (e.g., 'every 3 weeks'), convert this value to days (e.g., 21 days).
definition.missing_value_rule: If the treatment cycle frequency is not documented, is ambiguous, or refers only to hourly medication dosing (e.g., q6h), represent as null.
definition.name: treatment_cycle_frequency

definition.description: The primary stated objective for the patient's medical treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the explicit goal of treatment mentioned in the pretreatment record, specifically looking for mentions of functional targets (e.g., ambulation), disease-modifying targets (e.g., preventing progression), or palliative targets (e.g., symptom management).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no treatment goals are documented.
definition.name: treatment_goals

definition.description: The best overall response to treatment as determined by radiographic or clinical criteria.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the documented response category (e.g., Complete Response, Partial Response, Stable Disease, or Progressive Disease) associated with the most recent evaluation of the treatment's effect on the disease burden.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no specific response category is documented.
definition.name: treatment_response

definition.description: TTF-1 (Thyroid Transcription Factor-1) protein expression in lung tumor cells as determined by immunohistochemistry.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the result of the TTF-1 immunohistochemistry stain from the pathology or ancillary studies section of the patient record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if TTF-1 testing was not performed, the result is not documented, or the documentation is ambiguous.
definition.name: ttf1_expression

evidence_ids: at most 12 representative supplied modeling evidence IDs
themes.name: theme

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
